=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:953-959,1222-1229 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: open_earlier_reports() collects item URLs from earlier audit report PRs with `EARLIER_REPORT_ITEM_RE.finditer(text)`, and render_model_input() passes them into the current model input without applying the current `ISSUE_PR_AUDIT_REDACT_PRIVATE_IN_PUBLIC` redaction.
  WHY: An earlier report written while redaction was off can carry full private-repository URLs into a run with redaction on, and the model may write them into the public committed report, which bypasses the D7 redaction contract. Severity disagreement: gemini, minimax, luna and glm rated MAJOR; sonnet rated NIT because the trigger is narrow (redaction switched off and back on while an earlier report PR was still open).
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:1080-1095,1443-1462 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In the classify() carry-over block, carried-over blocked entries set `"repo": repo_part`, which is the redacted `private:<hash>` state-key prefix, while fresh entries from _digest_item use the real `owner/name`.
  WHY: render_telegram groups by `entry["repo"]`, so a capped redacted repository shows up as two groups, one of them under the hash. The "N across M repos" header overcounts M, and the `(repo, number)` digest sort splits that repository into two runs.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:1054,1070-1095 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Carried-over blocked entries are appended to `digest["blocked"]`, but no repository's `cov["blocked"]` is incremented for them.
  WHY: The per-repository Coverage lines and the `ISSUE_PR_AUDIT_REPO` log line (`blocked=0` on a read_failed repository) understate blocked counts and contradict the Metrics Appendix and Telegram totals, which are computed from `len(digest["blocked"])`. All reviewers rated it NIT or LOW.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:943-952 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: In open_earlier_reports(), `except (ApiError, ValueError): break` stops the whole scan when one earlier-report PR's files or contents read fails.
  WHY: Later matching PRs (up to EARLIER_REPORT_MAX_PRS) are never examined, so their items and plans are missing from the model input and the model may plan duplicate fixes. Using `continue` would keep the fail-open behaviour.
- changelog.d/10153-issue-pr-audit.md:11 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The documented per-run API budget ("3 more") and the module docstring's "GitHub API budget" section (scripts/issue_pr_audit.py lines 26-45) leave out open_earlier_reports(), which adds up to 9 REST calls (up to 3 listing pages plus 2 calls for each of up to 3 matching PRs).
  WHY: The budget documented for operators, which CLAUDE.md §14 requires for batched helpers, is now too low. This is documentation drift, not a crash.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:566-582 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `load_settings()` (scripts/issue_pr_audit.py line 164) reads `ISSUE_PR_AUDIT_MAX_WINDOW_PAGES`, but the collect step does not forward that repository variable into the environment, and README.md has no row for it.
  WHY: Setting a repository variable with this name has no effect, and the audit always uses the default page cap of 10.
- README.md:~600-617 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `ISSUE_PR_AUDIT_MAX_WINDOW_PAGES` (scripts/issue_pr_audit.py line 164, default 10, bounds 1-100) is missing from the README variable table and from the collect step env in .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml (line 574 exports only ISSUE_PR_AUDIT_MAX_OPEN_PAGES).
  WHY: Nothing crashes, but the documented variable surface no longer matches the script, and the window page cap cannot be tuned the way the sibling settings can.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Coverage must list "per repository, items in window, flagged, deep-reviewed, blocked, read failures; cursor clamps and gaps", and the prompt must "name every cursor clamp, truncated listing and read failure as a coverage gap" (including the README's `fallback=self`).
  expected_change_site: scripts/issue_pr_audit.py render_model_input(), "### Coverage" block (lines 1208-1215)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: discover_repos() (line 333) records `truncated`, `excluded`, `skipped_archived` and `fallback=self`, and classify() copies them into `digest["discovery"]` (line ~1110). render_model_input() emits only the per-repository `digest["coverage"]` rows (line 1210) and never reads `digest["discovery"]`, so the model cannot name the repositories the cap left out or a failed discovery. These appear only in the job log.
- requirement: "Each part below is inert without the others, and each has its own kill switch: ... `APPLY_ANALYSIS_DOC_GLOB_EXTRA=none` stops the hand-off" (the Rollout section also lists it as a rollback option)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml (steps near lines 1573 and 1837) and .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml (step near line 187), next to the `APPLY_ANALYSIS_ON_MAIN_ENABLED` env line
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: Neither workflow references `APPLY_ANALYSIS_DOC_GLOB_EXTRA`; only `APPLY_ANALYSIS_ON_MAIN_ENABLED` is forwarded, so the variable never reaches `apply_analysis_on_main.sh`. The README, changelog and agents fragment only document the limitation, and the only remaining switch stops every hand-off stream. The workflows are outside this PR's `files_touched` grant, so a follow-up issue is needed. (z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly declined to raise this, calling it a documented, deferred residual.)
- requirement: The module-level "GitHub API budget" docstring and the changelog numbers must match the calls collect() actually makes (CLAUDE.md §14 / §15).
  expected_change_site: scripts/issue_pr_audit.py module docstring (lines 26-45) and changelog.d/10153-issue-pr-audit.md line 11
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: open_earlier_reports(), called from collect() (line 901), adds 1-3 pages of `/repos/{host}/pulls?state=open` plus up to 3 file listings and 3 content reads (up to 9 REST calls). The docstring does not name these, and the changelog still says "3 more" rather than up to 12.
- requirement: "Coverage": per repository, include items in window, flagged, deep-reviewed, blocked, and read failures.
  expected_change_site: scripts/issue_pr_audit.py classify() and render_model_input()
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: Coverage records have no deep-reviewed count, and the per-repository Coverage lines at lines 1210-1214 contain only items, flagged, blocked, status and cursor information.
- requirement: The documentation must match the script's env surface for variables operators tune (README "#### Variables" table; CLAUDE.md §4 default requirement).
  expected_change_site: README.md "#### Variables" table (around line 184)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: `ISSUE_PR_AUDIT_MAX_WINDOW_PAGES` is read by `load_settings` (scripts/issue_pr_audit.py line 164, default 10, bounds 1–100) and referenced in the module docstring (line 31). It is not in the README variable table and not exported in the workflow collect step env. This is documentation drift, not a runtime bug.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:open_earlier_reports(), line 957 (`EARLIER_REPORT_ITEM_RE.finditer(text)`); render_model_input(), line 1228 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Item URLs from earlier reports reach the model input as written, without the current `ISSUE_PR_AUDIT_REDACT_PRIVATE_IN_PUBLIC` redaction, while every other path goes through `repo_display()`.
  WHY: The trigger is narrow (redaction switched off and back on while an earlier report PR was open), but this path skips the README redaction contract, and private names could land in the public report. Suggested fix: drop or hash URLs from redacted private repositories.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:classify() carry-over block, line 1083 (`"repo": repo_part,`); _digest_item; render_telegram, line 1443 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Carried-over blocked entries for a redacted private repository take `repo` = `private:<hash>`, while fresh entries use the real `owner/name`.
  WHY: Telegram shows one repository as two groups (one under the hash), the "N across M repos" count is one too high, and the `(repo, number)` sort splits the repository.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:line 1054, `cov["blocked"] += 1` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Carried-over entries are appended to `blocked` without updating any coverage record, so a read_failed repository logs `blocked=0`.
  WHY: The Coverage counts disagree with the Metrics Appendix total (`len(digest['blocked'])`) and with the Telegram header.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:open_earlier_reports(), line 951, `except (ApiError, ValueError): break` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A transient error on one earlier-report PR stops the scan of later matching PRs.
  WHY: The model loses dedupe context and may plan the same cause again. Using `continue` keeps the fail-open behaviour.
- changelog.d/10153-issue-pr-audit.md:line 11 (`..., up to 20 for blocked-item logs, 3 more`); module docstring "GitHub API budget" (line 43) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: open_earlier_reports() adds up to 9 calls per run, and neither the docstring nor the changelog counts them.
  WHY: The documented per-run API budget (CLAUDE.md §14) is too low.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Requirement: Coverage must list "per repository, items in window, flagged, deep-reviewed, blocked, read failures; cursor clamps and gaps", and the prompt must "name every cursor clamp, truncated listing and read failure as a coverage gap" (README: `fallback=self`).
  Expected change site: scripts/issue_pr_audit.py, render_model_input(), in the "### Coverage" block at line 1208.
  Evidence of absence: discover_repos() records `truncated`, `excluded`, `skipped_archived` and `fallback=self` in `digest["discovery"]`, but render_model_input() never reads `digest["discovery"]`.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  Requirement: "each has its own kill switch: ... `APPLY_ANALYSIS_DOC_GLOB_EXTRA=none` stops the hand-off"
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml and .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml, next to `APPLY_ANALYSIS_ON_MAIN_ENABLED` (`APPLY_ANALYSIS_DOC_GLOB_EXTRA: ${{ vars.APPLY_ANALYSIS_DOC_GLOB_EXTRA || 'analysis/issue-pr-audit-*.md' }}`).
  Evidence of absence: Neither workflow references the variable. The last run only rewrote the docs. The workflows are outside `files_touched`, so an explicit follow-up issue is needed.
- Rejected pass-1 findings: gemini's "failed repository keeps its cursor" via `list_open`; gemini's `next_state["repos"]` ordering and `_write_json` atomicity; glm's `ISSUE_PR_AUDIT_MAX_WINDOW_PAGES` missing from the README (doc nit only). (3 related items)
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (risk score 2): `break`→`continue` at line 951; `display_to_name` map for carried `repo
